# Repository policy

Before repository work, read and follow `AGENTS.md` and
`baseline/aiscb-core.md`. Read `baseline/catalog.json` and use
`python3 scripts/repository_policy.py MODULE_ID [MODULE_ID ...]` from the
repository root to load every matching module before affected work.
Follow the specification, approval, implementation, and verification workflow
in `AGENTS.md`. Do not substitute a generated complete file or remembered rules.
If files or the loader are unavailable, stop affected work and report that this
Copilot surface cannot use this repository's modular adapter.
